_: The edit, in frames of the 30 fps film. Every cut point was read off the supplied files themselves (docs/source-cuts.md).

cartoon._frames: source frames 0-222: the scene up to its last frame of Cosmo and Wanda waving their wands (222). The file's last three frames, 223-225, are the next shot (a wide shot of Timmy with them) and are left out.
cartoon._crop: the 4:3 picture inside the file's blurred pillarbox, x 280-1640 (inside the black edge lines at 273-275 and 1644-1646), y 30-1050: exactly 4:3, square pixels, no stretch
cartoon._audioWhole: the clip's whole sound (0 to 7.533333 s) goes through the TV speaker and the room and is levelled as one piece, exactly as in the earlier deliveries; only then is it cut at audioOut, the end of frame 222, so every sample it keeps is unchanged

card._: the card the set plays where the Nickelodeon ident used to be (comp/card.py): the IN YOUR SHOE logo, white on black, from the cut after the cartoon's last wand frame to the glitch, film frames 223-321; its last frame (98) is where the glitch interrupts it: the glitch freezes on it and stutters back to the frame before, as it did on the ident

logo._: the logo supplied in the conversation on 10 November 2026: the white IN YOUR SHOE wordmark on a transparent ground (brand/README.md)
logo._width: the wordmark spans this fraction of the signal's width: the same width as the countdown that follows

card._chimeAt: card frame of the sting's second, lighter chime (0.6 s in)

countdown._: the countdown's signal breaks through during the glitch's last frames (showing its starting value); its clock starts when the signal locks, at clockOriginFrame, and it runs to the film's last frame
